name: neuruh
description: Neuruh Public Commons micro-plugins: small, inspectable, offline agent-operations utilities for bounded context, economical routing, proof projection, state diffs and clean handoffs.

plugins.name: neuruh-public-micro-plugins
plugins.description: Public-safe agent operations. Three stdio MCP tools: compile a bounded context packet, pick the cheapest capable route, and project a public-safe proof card. Four skills, plus CLIs for state diff and handoff packs. Offline after install; no account or API key.
